scope: The exact 53 different faces in the allowed 32755-face baseline; not 53 confirmed reference defects. Foundation goal remains paused.

findings.decision: The source exclusion is redundant: source is normally a nontoken creature. A sacrificed token copy is sacrificed by its controller, who also controls the look-back trigger, not their own opponent (CR 701.21a/603.10a). No rules bug.

All players read PerformedTotal, never the current player's own Performed payment. The 3/0 mana witness gives both players 3. Existing upstream issue #139; Alliance of Arms is the retained total-payment control.

Cloak produces at most one permanent. Recorded and Result After/index0 select that permanent, or none. A producer-wide normal-form change needs its own receipt-family boundary; no current gameplay defect.

Keep optional resolving payment and its PaymentChosen follow-ups (CR 118.12). Receipt consumption and attempted payment differ from unconditional follow-ups around an optional body; the report's preferred spelling is not sufficient to drop those guards.

Candidate is scoped to Source by the outer ObjectMatches, so its other-creatures count excludes the entering Regent. Splitting the conjunction is a valid normal-form preference; no candidate rebinding counterexample was found.

Keep captured target identity in the delayed ability. Its own attack/damage event may name the same object, but delayed turn events do not supply an object subject. Lurker also uses the exact exile cost and post-cost receipt. No blanket Target-to-EventSubject rewrite; a capture-frame witness is needed for broader unification.

Counter receipt preserves the target's mana value even when countering fails; the official TSR notes support this. Current generator saves the target before the counter. No dependence on successfully countering is introduced.

ObjectMatches does not add an InZone(Battlefield) predicate; Source can be read with its last-known identity after departure. Filter Condition(PlayerDid) and the history comparison preserve the same actor, time window and own-spell exclusion. A frontend simplification is possible, not a demonstrated source bug.

Acting reads the current player receiving this life-loss operation. This preserves the controller in Reaper's attack trigger, the damaged player in its combat trigger, and the owner for Personal Incarnation. Explicitly naming those same players is stylistic.

Keep explicit ability Source in the reflexive body/announcement. A reflexive payment is not automatically an object event that rebinds EventSubject to the departed source. Compound entry/death frames and new graveyard incarnations must remain distinct.
The selected population is already the controller's graveyard. Repeating InZone in that population's filter changes no candidates.

Both prevent all combat damage to/from the same creature for the turn. Separate replacement effects versus one disjunction requires testing overlapping self-damage and ordering with other replacements before consolidation. No concrete rules error established.

On entry, EventSubject is Source. On the haunt-death branch, the haunted creature is departed and the haunting card is exiled, so neither exclusion removes a battlefield creature. Preserve the separate identities despite equivalent exclusion here.

Chance selection versus ChooseObjects/AtRandom needs population, count and batch proof. No demonstrated change in random distribution or legal population in this one-card return; do not label an uncommon wrapper wrong.

Mandatory resolving sacrifice payment and a plain sacrifice effect require a failed-payment/replacement witness before substitution. Existing CostObjects Inputs/Before preserves sacrificed mana value and PaymentChosen. CR 118.12 resolving costs are not casting/activation costs; Yasharn/Angel of Jubilation alone is not a counterexample.

Keep optional resolving payment and its PaymentChosen follow-ups (CR 118.12). Receipt consumption and attempted payment differ from unconditional follow-ups around an optional body; the report's preferred spelling is not sufficient to drop those guards.

With one target, Recorded from control change still names the attempted object even when changing its controller fails. It is not merely a successful-move receipt. Illegal sole target stops the spell. Target spelling is equivalent here, not a fix.

The pronoun in these holder-own triggers names EventSubject. Change only the token self-target sacrifice and granted self-tap counter recipient; do not globally equate granting Source with a granted holder.
Affected denotes the characteristic subject being evaluated. Here it is the same single target. Keep the existing descriptive characteristic contract.

Scheme/plane/emblem/self-departure damage now uses the existing damage_each_recipient path. Explicit ForEachPlayer binding connects each opponent to their own hand count. The prior damage_action fast path evaluated one amount before building its recipient batch.

The outer event is this source entering or attacking; its EventSubject is the sacrifice exclusion in both branches. Equivalent to Source in this particular self trigger, without a global event-reference rewrite.

Use the specific exiled-dead-card reference: CostObjects Resolution(0), component [0], Performed, After, guarded by PaymentChosen and still-in-exile. CollectEvidence remains its separate component. Neither Source nor a Query of the old Graveyard EventDestination is a substitute. This clarifies Source binding; no new Source constructor/engine feature required.

Use DrawsCard filtered by Not(FirstDrawInOwnDrawStep(EventSubject)). Outside-step first draws trigger and each separate own draw step exempts its own first draw. Upstream #270; Orcish Bowmasters control.

The one targeted opponent is the only Prior(That) player in the per-recipient life-loss row. Optional one-target return selects zero or one object either as Targets or scalar Target. No changed outcome established.

Keep captured target identity in the delayed ability. Its own attack/damage event may name the same object, but delayed turn events do not supply an object subject. Lurker also uses the exact exile cost and post-cost receipt. No blanket Target-to-EventSubject rewrite; a capture-frame witness is needed for broader unification.

All players read PerformedTotal, never the current player's own Performed payment. The 3/0 mana witness gives both players 3. Existing upstream issue #139; Alliance of Arms is the retained total-payment control.

Keep optional resolving payment and its PaymentChosen follow-ups (CR 118.12). Receipt consumption and attempted payment differ from unconditional follow-ups around an optional body; the report's preferred spelling is not sufficient to drop those guards.
The one-top-card exile has zero or one result, so its full After Transition and scalar Result select the same available card. An aggregate receipt is not itself a rules error.

Before sacrifice Transition plus CurrentOrLastKnown pins the exact original object and its power. A bare event subject is safe only if the consumer preserves the same last-known view; retaining the explicit receipt is appropriate.

Requiring every able blocker to block the equipped creature and requiring that creature to be blocked by each able creature express the same blocking requirement here. Preserve combat legality; no source bug established.

The mirrored pair events bind attacker/blocker roles separately. EventSubject in the blocks trigger is the blocker, so the proposed spelling may coincide, but a pair-role test must establish both role captures before changing general event references.

The combat-damage event subject is the source creature here. Connive is object-directed (CR 701.50a-b); the object's current/last controller performs it. The backend correctly calls connive_n with that object and ignores the generic actor field. A Source/ControllerOf cosmetic rewrite is not a fix and must not override keyword semantics.

One optional sacrifice over (another creature OR token), followed by one reflexive trigger. The previous branch choice also chose one sacrifice, not two; no distinct gameplay witness was found. Use the same normal form as other disjunctive sacrifice templates.

ACardWasExiledThisWay tests After card characteristics, not Before library/permanent characteristics. Preserve APermanentWasExiledThisWay Before semantics. Count(Matching(full After Transition)) and the independent scalar Result spellings still differ; do not count that spelling as an unresolved correctness defect.

Keep explicit ability Source in the reflexive body/announcement. A reflexive payment is not automatically an object event that rebinds EventSubject to the departed source. Compound entry/death frames and new graveyard incarnations must remain distinct.

Track ordinary moves into a hand, then use the full After Transition for a perpetual follow-up. Keep exact CostObjects and PaymentChosen on resolving-cost returns (Alora); do not globally replace scalar references.

Acting reads the current player receiving this life-loss operation. This preserves the controller in Reaper's attack trigger, the damaged player in its combat trigger, and the owner for Personal Incarnation. Explicitly naming those same players is stylistic.

CR 611.2e: is a Phyrexian applies simultaneously with entry, including type-dependent entry replacements (Metallic Mimic); use entry Changes, not a later continuous effect. Eight matching templates/cards corrected with entry flags. Upstream #272.

Keep explicit ability Source in the reflexive body/announcement. A reflexive payment is not automatically an object event that rebinds EventSubject to the departed source. Compound entry/death frames and new graveyard incarnations must remain distinct.

Aggregate(Created, ManaValue, Sum) supports the zero-or-one creation, including zero targets. Scalar replacement needs the same empty/LKI behavior and one token incarnation. No arbitrary aggregate-to-scalar rewrite.

All players read PerformedTotal, never the current player's own Performed payment. The 3/0 mana witness gives both players 3. Existing upstream issue #139; Alliance of Arms is the retained total-payment control.

The Pump, keyword and attack requirement apply in their rules-defined layers; swapping those cross-layer list positions changes no result. Do not reorder arbitrary same-layer changes merely to match written word order.
Acting is the named one-player life-loss row. It is the sole target for that operation. An explicit target is a possible normal form, not an additional rules correction.
Entry replacement's EventSubject is the entering Source, cast or not. Own-spell exclusion is the same. A global Source/EventSubject rewrite would be unsafe in other events.

The pronoun in these holder-own triggers names EventSubject. Change only the token self-target sacrifice and granted self-tap counter recipient; do not globally equate granting Source with a granted holder.

Spirit replaces old creature types; no additive clause. Full returned After Transition includes every resulting card, including a returned meld. Upstream #271 concerns only Add versus Set; receipt tracking is local.

Keep DuplicateLastKnown so copying the departed card retains definition/perpetual changes. OwnedBy beside an own Graveyard departure versus explicit InZone is a separate equivalent filter spelling, not justification for switching to a live Duplicate.
Keep exact activation sacrifice component Inputs/Before with CurrentOrLastKnown. It records the sacrificed original's counters rather than looking at a later zone incarnation.

The guarded optional look and optional reveal remain separate choices. Compare declining the look, failure to reveal, and an empty library before changing the program; optional/payment wrappers are not automatically interchangeable.

A one-point redirection with NextOccurrence may coincide with a TotalDamage(1) shield for ordinary positive damage. Zero/prevented/replaced/split events and replacement consumption need a distinguishing witness. Keep the explicit one-point action; no unconditional normalization of shields.

EventHistory does not rebind the enclosing event frame. Outer EventSubject remains the attacking Warden and equals Source in this own attack trigger. No current rebinding witness; normal-form cleanup is optional.
Basic Plains already denotes a land. The explicit Land test is redundant; retain it without introducing a comparison alias.

Use DrawsCard filtered by Not(FirstDrawInOwnDrawStep(EventSubject)). Outside-step first draws trigger and each separate own draw step exempts its own first draw. Upstream #270; Orcish Bowmasters control.
